title: A THEORETICAL SURVEY ON FOUNDATION MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical analysis of generalization bounds for fairness metrics (demographic parity and equal odds) under domain shifts, alongside qualitative comparison of model recommendations using prompt variations with racial identifiers (e.g., 'white fan' vs. 'black fan').
Theoretical analysis and formulation of generalization bounds for fairness metrics (demographic parity and equal odds) evaluating the influence of sensitive attributes on predicted outcomes.
